messages:
maria: Quick pulse — token-attrib pipeline. Owners, milestone, blockers? We're aiming to flip on billing/tier mapping for canary next Wed (3/31). Need final schema + smoke results. cc @alex @samir

alex: I've got a schema PR open: #4521. Waiting on eng-sre review for the env flags. Plan is to merge Tue EOD, deploy Wed morning to the canary pool.

samir: Re: smoke — ran local ingest against the sample set, latency looks fine but ~1% of events missing the attribution key. Investigating root cause.

jen: eng-sre note — canary pool capacity is available. Recommend feature-flag gated rollout. Also we need the token-latency histogram emitted in telemetry (event: `token.latency_ms`).

maria: Who owns the event schema update? @oliver?

oliver: I'll own the schema change. PR incoming in the next hour. Will add a backward-compatible alias for the old field so downstreams aren't broken.

samir: Found a likely root cause — the event deduper drops events when header `X-Trace` is absent. Quick fix in a branch, but it needs ingest-team approval (cc @nina).

nina: ingest-team looking now. Small change, can merge after the test run passes. I'll coordinate smoke testing with samir.

telemetry-bot: smoke-test: failed 1 check — token.latency histogram missing. See https://go/telemetry/1234 for details.

alex: Pushed a small config diff to enable histogram emit in dev env (branch `attr-config`). Config snippet:```
features:
  token_attribution: true
  emit_token_latency: true
```

maria: Action items: 1) oliver: schema PR -> merge by 10:30 PT; 2) alex: config PR -> set flag for canary; 3) nina: merge ingest fix + run smoke; 4) samir: validate missing keys <1000 events. Ping here when done.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 20m quick-huddle at 09:30 PT if the group wants a short sync.

samir: Rerunning smoke now against canary sample. ETA ~20m.

nina: Merged ingest fix, kicked off test suite, smoke-run started.

telemetry-bot: smoke-test: pass. token.latency histogram present. report: https://go/telemetry/1234/report

maria: If smoke passes, can we flip the flag to 5% traffic tomorrow? Need product sign-off for the rollout window.

alex: We have bandwidth for a 5% canary tomorrow at 2pm PT. Will monitor success metrics; adding an abort rule if error rate >0.5%.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post the rollout announcement once product confirms. Closing this thread unless new blockers crop up.
